title: PET-Guided Navigation with Electromagnetic Tracking during PSMA-RadioGuided Surgery: Innovative Bimodal Detection of Nodal Metastases in Prostate Cancer Patients
official: PET-Guided Navigation with Electromagnetic Tracking during PSMA-RadioGuided Surgery: Innovative Bimodal Detection of Nodal Metastases in Prostate Cancer Patients
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the role of PSMA-PET-guided navigation with electromagnetic tracking combined with PSMA-RGS to improve bCR rate (PSA <0.1 ng/mL at 6 weeks after surgery) in miN1 PCa patients with primary or recurrent disease undergoing RARP + ePLND or SLND.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. -	Male participants who are at least 18 years of age on the day of signing informed consent -	Ability to provide written informed consent -	Newly diagnosed miN1M0 Pca or oligorecurrent miN1M0 PCa -	Eligibility for RARP and ePLND or SPLND
Exclusion criteria:
1. -	Neoadjuvant or adjuvant, previous or concomitant hormonal treatment for prostate cancer -	Inability to complete the imaging protocol  -	miM1 at PSMA-PET  -	Contraindications to the planned surgical procedure, including robot-assisted surgery -	Cardiac pacemaker which can cause interference with the navigation system
